⬡ How It Works

Three layers of protection

Every email is analysed at multiple levels — text, links, and images — in one automated pipeline.

1

Gmail Fetch via n8n

n8n connects to your Gmail account and pulls recent messages, extracting subject, sender, and full body text.

2

AI Classification

Each email is sent to the local Cyberastryx BiLSTM model via the FastAPI endpoint and classified instantly.

3

URL & Image Scan

Links and embedded images are checked for phishing signals, brand impersonation, and suspicious patterns.

4

Live Results

The frontend receives the full results and displays each email with a colour-coded verdict and confidence score.
